en.summary: Brent crude oil traded below the 100 dollar mark as a key development from Saudi Arabia eased market concerns. The East-West Pipeline, which bypasses the Strait of Hormuz, resumed operations though returning to full capacity will take time.

en.summary: Gold prices recovered above 4,360 dollars per ounce after falling below 4,300 dollars on September 22. Investors face a busy schedule ahead featuring US employment, durable goods orders, JOLTS, PCE, and non-farm payroll data.
